summary: Comprehensive price block for Buy Box showing price, strikethrough, VAT, and shipping.
features: Main price with customizable size and color
Sale price with discount flag and strikethrough
Base price, VAT, and shipping cost display
shortDescription: The Price block presents complete pricing information within the Buy Box. It displays the main price with extensive customization for size and color, along with optional strikethrough pricing for sales showing RRP comparisons. Discount flags highlight savings with customizable colors. Additional lines show base price for unit comparison, VAT information, and shipping costs—all meeting European e-commerce regulatory requirements. Each element pulls from configurable data sources.
